svg.title: Joint papers between the members of four institutes
svg.desc: Network with 14 nodes and 20 connections in 4 groups: Physics, Chemistry, Biology and Computing. Most connected: Silva (4 connections). Heaviest connection: Weber → Nair (9). Nair (group Physics): connected to Weber (weight 9), Costa (weight 6) and Chen (weight 5). Weber (group Physics): connected to Nair (weight 9), Costa (weight 4) and Berger (weight 1). Costa (group Physics): connected to Weber (weight 4), Nair (weight 6) and Lindqvist (weight 3). Lindqvist (group Chemistry): connected to Okafor (weight 7), Tanaka (weight 2) and Costa (weight 3). Tanaka (group Chemistry): connected to Okafor (weight 3), Lindqvist (weight 2) and Hughes (weight 1). Okafor (group Chemistry): connected to Lindqvist (weight 7), Tanaka (weight 3) and Silva (weight 4). Moreau (group Biology): connected to Silva (weight 8), Kowalski (weight 2) and Adeyemi (weight 2). Silva (group Biology): connected to Moreau (weight 8), Hughes (weight 5), Okafor (weight 4) and Yilmaz (weight 6). Hughes (group Biology): connected to Silva (weight 5), Kowalski (weight 4) and Tanaka (weight 1). Kowalski (group Biology): connected to Hughes (weight 4) and Moreau (weight 2). Berger (group Computing): connected to Yilmaz (weight 6) and Weber (weight 1). Yilmaz (group Computing): connected to Berger (weight 6), Chen (weight 5) and Silva (weight 6). Chen (group Computing): connected to Yilmaz (weight 5), Adeyemi (weight 3) and Nair (weight 5). Adeyemi (group Computing): connected to Chen (weight 3) and Moreau (weight 2).
